facts.text: “Fever Dream” by Alex Warren is in its 30th week in the Dutch Top 40.
Back after 47 years: “September” by Earth, Wind & Fire is in the US Hot 100 again this week.
“Man I Need” by Olivia Dean is in its 57th week in the US Hot 100.
“Patient Zero” by Taylor Swift entered the UK Top 100 straight at #1 this week.
Back after 12 years: “Just Give Me A Reason” by Pink is in the UK Top 100 again this week.
“Mr. Brightside” by The Killers is in its 523rd week in the UK Top 100.
